name: zcode-cli
description: A cross-platform TypeScript Node.js CLI with a small TUI and optional SEA packaging.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --dir ../.. exec turbo run build --root-turbo-json=apps/zcode-cli/turbo.json --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/packages/* --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/tools/*
scripts.check: corepack pnpm registry:check && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test
scripts.clean: corepack pnpm --dir ../.. exec turbo run clean --root-turbo-json=apps/zcode-cli/turbo.json --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/packages/* --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/tools/*
scripts.coverage: corepack pnpm --dir ../.. exec turbo run coverage --root-turbo-json=apps/zcode-cli/turbo.json --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/packages/* --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/tools/*
scripts.lint:fix: corepack pnpm --dir ../.. exec turbo run lint:fix --root-turbo-json=apps/zcode-cli/turbo.json --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/packages/* --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/tools/*
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --dir ../.. exec turbo run test --root-turbo-json=apps/zcode-cli/turbo.json --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/packages/* --filter=./apps/zcode-cli/tools/*
scripts.test:browser-headless: pnpm --filter @zcode/browser-use-plugin... build && pnpm --filter @zcode/browser-use-plugin exec vitest run test/headless-browser.e2e.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @zcode/tui build && corepack pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./tools/*" -r run typecheck
